main_text.head: Stomachi. Cibi.
main_text.p: Stomachi ἀνομοξίαν sæpè sedat mutatio loci: ubi cibi melius beant, aut juvant. Capt. 1. 2. v. 27. Vide etiam Asin. 1. 2. v. 16. & Most. 3. 1. v. 2.
main_text.head: Strenarum. Præmiorum. Munerum. Donorum.
main_text.p: Calendis Martijs Matronæ Junoni sacrificabant, ut is annus ab exordio totus eis esset felix & faustus, & in partu & in amore conjugali: atq; etiam munera sibi missitare solebant. Mil. 3. 1. v. 96. Atque hæc festa Matronalia dicebantur.
Martial. lib. 8. Ep. 86. Saturnalia muliebria appellat.
Vide Macrob. lib. 1. c. 9. Tibull. Eleg. 1. l. 3. & l. 4. Eleg. 2. Item Comment. Cruq. ad Horat. lib. 3. Od. 8. nec non Servium ad 8. Æneid. Virg.
main_text.head: Stultitiæ. Nugarum. Sycophantiæ. Scurrarum.
main_text.p: Qui cum stulto agit, stultior est.
Graphicum sycophantæ characterem vide totâ illâ scenâ 2. act. 4. Trin.

page.notes: Greek word in the first paragraph is printed as "ἀνομοξίαν"; the Greek is uncertain at this scan resolution. The first paragraph's Greek and the Latin "Stomachi" line are copied as best read. The catchword "Et stul-" appears at the lower right as a catchword-like line and is given in the text.
